description: Context: We need an automated CI gate that prevents prompt-set regressions from reaching main. This PR adds a lightweight prompt-set regression checker that runs as part of eval-harness CI and publishes key metrics to Prometheus. Motivation: recent regressions in structured-output prompts caused a customer incident (SUP-1293). Goals: (1) fail CI when prompt-set quality drops above configured thresholds, (2) emit eval metrics for dashboards and alerting, (3) provide an operator-friendly runbook for triage. Changes: - New CI step eval-harness/prompt-regression that runs nightly and on PRs touching eval-related code. - Implementation of hooks/prompt_regression_gate.py which: computes per-prompt metrics (exact-match, semantic-similarity, custom heuristics), compares against baseline stored in eval-harness/examples/sample_prompt_set.json, and returns non-zero exit on threshold breach. - Prometheus integration that emits eval.metric.{prompt_set}.{metric} and tag labels for model, commit, and run_id. - config/default_gates.yaml with default thresholds and a single opt-in allowlist for unstable prompts. - End-to-end test test_prompt_gate_end_to_end.py + fixtures to simulate a small regression and ensure gate fails as expected. - Documentation: docs/eval-harness/quality-gates.md with config examples and triage steps. Checklist: - [x] Implementation code - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Prometheus metrics emitted - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] CI pipeline entry - [x] Reviewer approvals Notes: initial integration run showed one flaky assertion in the e2e test (floating-point tolerance). Fixed by introducing seeded RNG and relaxed semantic-similarity tolerance for small sample sets. Backwards compatibility: gate is opt-in for repositories until rollout is complete, controlled via pipeline.yml and default_gates.yaml.
review_thread: Diego Morales: Nice end-to-end flow. Two asks: (1) make the baseline snapshot storage S3-compatible (we may later store baselines in dedicated bucket), (2) split the large function compute_metrics() into smaller helpers for testability.

Ava Patel: Addressed both. Baseline loader now supports local fs and s3 (ENV configurable). Refactored compute_metrics into compute_exact_match, compute_semantic_similarity, compute_custom_heuristics. Added unit tests for helpers.
Sofia Chen: Can we expose a per-prompt 'ignore_until' date in default_gates.yaml so we can temporarily mute noisy prompts during model rollouts?
Ava Patel: Added ignore_until and an allowlist with rationale fields; added docs section on muting prompts and recommended TTLs.
Maya Singh: Observability nit — include model_version and commit_sha as metric labels. Also please add a dashboard link to the PR description.
Ava Patel: Included model_version and commit_sha in emitted labels. Added Grafana dashboard fragment and link in docs. CI re-run after addressing flaky assertion.
release_notes: Add CI prompt-set regression gating: nightly and PR-level checks, Prometheus metrics, and operator docs. Gate is opt-in via config/default_gates.yaml.
